g.text: Nib, a young frogman, has asked me to catch some live toads to eat
the slugs in his camp's bogweed. He's given me four reed traps. I
should set them where the toads go, round the Mire.
Trap set by the Rain Stone: 0/1
Trap set far east of Nib: 0/1
Really? Here, take these, I made them myself. Set one in each wet hollow round the Mire, then go back and check
There's one by the Rain Stone, then one by the pond down south. Also just here by the bridge, and another out a
